response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience and demonstrated hands-on work with agentic workflows and event-driven systems, but lacks clear evidence of executive leadership at scale, production-scale fintech AI systems, or team scaling beyond 10 people — critical for a CTO role in a regulated fintech scale-up.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic AI infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven track record in event-driven, distributed systems (e.g., GISCollective, DLang microservices)
Strong engineering culture contributions via workshops, TDD, and open-source tooling
concerns: No demonstrated experience in fintech infrastructure, credit risk, or regulatory compliance systems
Lacks evidence of leading teams beyond 10 engineers or developing senior technical leadership layers
No clear record of designing multi-agent frameworks with real-time financial data, feedback loops, or model-agnostic AI architecture
